soundness_flags.label: ass:gap-att-variance-margin
soundness_flags.one_line: Since V_s^gap=(1-varrho)^(-1)Var(A_s)+r Var(R_s) is at least V_s, ass:att-variance-margin already implies this margin with the same nu.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 (primitive realizations)
soundness_flags.one_line: “Relatively open” and “open chart” have no declared finite-dimensional parameter space, topology, or explicit calibration map, so the asserted open realization and displayed decimal are not presently reproducible mathematical claims.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 (uniform singular mapping)
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed supremum is over M_n although its local-gap condition is asymptotic for an entire array, and “bounded local selector gaps” supplies no bound; define an array class M(D) with sup_n|sqrt(n)(L_1-L_2)|<=D before asking for uniformity.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article treats outcome-dependent preliminary proxy/control selection as potentially endogenous and says that formal proxy-selection methods and post-selection inference remain future research.
Theorem 3 gives consistency and asymptotic normality for the article's doubly robust GMM estimator under its bridge-model and regularity conditions; it is fixed-structure inference.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Introduction, paragraphs on sample splitting and Definition 1 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes time-series sample-splitting validity under weak dependence and states that establishing splitting validity alone does not specify how to conduct inference on the second block.
The article compares PoSI and naive confidence intervals after model selection for a selected-model-dependent target.
The paper develops proximal influence-function, efficiency-bound, and locally efficient-estimator theory for fixed proximal structures.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a concrete finite-dimensional Gaussian parameter vector, its local-loss calibration map, and an explicit asymmetric parameter point that yields the reported coverage; then state relative openness in that parameter topology.
Replace the redundant gap-variance assumption with its one-line derivation from ass:att-variance-margin, and define a bounded-gap triangular-array class M(D) for the uniform split-inference question.
Add a worked observable diagnostic estimating rho_1^2-rho_2^2 and state whether a thresholded correction is valid when its confidence interval intersects zero.

recommended_next_step: Revise the model-class and primitive-realization specifications, then advance the field-tier selected-coverage kernel for Stage 0 review.
